name: mono-minimal
title: Mono Minimal
summary: Black, white and greys only; hierarchy purely from type size, weight and space. For premium products, studios, fashion, architecture and any brief that asks for minimal.
imagery: Black-and-white or desaturated photography with lots of negative space; one image per section at most.
rules: No colour: the accent is the ink colour; primary buttons are filled ink with on-accent text.
Headlines in Inter Tight 500, large, letterSpacing -1 to -2 at 36 px and up; body Inter 400 14-16 px.
Contrast of scale: pair one very large element with small text and skip the middle sizes.
Whitespace is the main material: 96-144 px between sections, wide outer margins.
Thin 1 px rules for structure; radius 0-2 px; no cards, no shadows, no gradients.
Small uppercase labels (12 px, letterSpacing 1) for navigation and metadata.
At most two weights per screen (400 and 500).
